newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian firm contracts 50,000 tonnes rice exports.
newsitem.headline: Indian firm contracts 50,000 tonnes rice exports.

text.p: India's Shivnath Rai Har Narayan said on Wednesday it had contracted in the past two days to export 50,000 tonnes of rice to the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) and Africa.

"We have signed contracts to export 50,000 tonnes of rice to the CIS and some African countries in the last two days," Prem Garg, managing director of Shivnath Rai Har Narayan, a leading Delhi foodgrains exporter, told Reuters by telephone.
Garg said the contracts were signed for five percent broken non-Basmati rice, 10 percent, 25 percent and 100 percent broken grades.
The contracts were signed in the range of $200 to $300 per tonne FOB, Garg said.
